text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Community Disputes Resolution (Composition of Offences under Part 2A) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 24 March 2025.

2. An offence under section 13K(4), 13L(5), 13N(1), 13O, 13P(1) or 13R(1) or (2) of the Act may be compounded by the Director‑General or a person authorised by the Director‑General in accordance with section 13U of the Act.
